vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇮🇳 Hindi. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Kurt, Deirdre, Divya and Gael met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Kurt, Deirdre, Divya, Gael are hurt.
🛡️ Gael, Ingrid, Tashi and Caleb met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Gael, Ingrid, Tashi, Caleb are hurt.
🛡️ Kurt, Gael and Ingrid met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Kurt is hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Kurt, Gael, Ingrid, Vasyl and Tashi met them at the door — 5 put down. Kurt, Gael, Ingrid, Vasyl, Tashi are hurt.
🛡️ Gael, Ingrid, Vasyl, Caleb and Yerbol met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Ingrid, Vasyl, Caleb, Yerbol are hurt.
🛡️ Gael, Ingrid, Caleb and Yerbol met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Caleb, Yerbol are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
🛡️ Gael, Ingrid and Tashi met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Gael is hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gael, Ingrid and Caleb met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Caleb is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nomsa just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
